verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-recorder, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or open-source deployment of Fathom. All evidence describes a vendor-hosted service reached through cloud API keys, webhooks, SDKs, and a hosted MCP endpoint (api.fathom.ai/mcp), none of which is self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
